description: This Java source file defines the HousekeeperStatsService class, which manages and reports statistics related to housekeeper tasks, including counters and timers, within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: HousekeeperStats
classes.description: Inner static class that encapsulates counters and timers for a specific housekeeper task type, providing methods to reset statistics.

methods.name: reportStats
methods.description: Scheduled method that logs current statistics and resets counters periodically.

methods.name: reportProcessed
methods.description: Records a processed task, incrementing counters based on success or reprocessing, and recording processing time.

methods.name: reportFailure
methods.description: Records a failed task, incrementing failure counters.

methods.name: HousekeeperStats
methods.description: Constructor for the HousekeeperStats class, initializing counters and timers for a specific task type.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Helper method to create and register a new StatsCounter.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all counters and timers within the HousekeeperStats instance.
